notes.title: Steam Demo Release - 21st of July
notes.notes: [p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]!!!THE TIME HAS ARRIVED!!![/h2][p][/p][p][b]The wait is almost over![/b] The Mr. Figs demo is set to launch on [b]July 21st at 8 AM BST[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]What Awaits You in the Demo?[/h3][p][/p][p]Prepare to dive into the [b]complete first area[/b] of Mr. Figs, packed with:[/p][list][*][p][b]Over 30 levels[/b] to conquer![/p][/*][*][p]Challenging [b]bosses[/b] to overcome![/p][/*][*][p]Hidden [b]secrets[/b] to uncover![/p][/*][*][p]An [b]A+ experience[/b] that will leave you wanting more![/p][/*][/list][p]The demo will be fully playable on both [b]Linux and Windows[/b], so everyone can join the fun.[/p][p][/p][h3]Your Feedback Matters![/h3][p][/p][p]Keep in mind that this is still a [b]work-in-progress[/b], and your feedback is incredibly valuable. If you have suggestions for improvement or just want to chat, join the [b]Mr. Figs Discord community ([/b][url="https://discord.gg/KndkA3BGXv"]https://discord.gg/KndkA3BGXv[/url]). I want to know what you think so I can make this game the best it can be![/p][p][/p][h3]Need Help?[/h3][p][/p][p]Encounter an issue? Don't worry! Reach out on the [b]Mr. Figs Discord:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/KndkA3BGXv"]https://discord.gg/KndkA3BGXv[/url]. I'll be there to assist you and answer any questions you have.[/p]
